SessionCard.description: The card a session worked on, as every event carries it.

created.description: The day the card was filed, as on every event.
created.title: Created

SessionCard.title: SessionCard

description:
What happened in one session: its card, role, start, end, model time and tokens.

What's unknown is left off, never sent as zero: the card for a session on none, and
the model time and tokens of a session with no call that recorded them. sprint-metrics
holds a session once by its card (or none), role, start and end.

card_id.description: The card, as `repo#number`. A review's card is the one its pull request closes, or the one its event names when it closes none. Absent for a session on no card, such as a retro or a review of a package bump.
card_id.title: Card Id

input_tokens.description: Its model calls' prompt tokens; absent as for the time.
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

model_seconds.description: Its model calls' time, in whole seconds. A call with no time recorded adds nothing; absent when no call of it has one.
model_seconds.title: Model Seconds

output_tokens.description: Its model calls' completion tokens; absent as for the time.
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

role.description: The role that worked. A later MINOR may add roles.
role.title: Role

sprint.description: The sprint whose days it started in.
sprint.title: Sprint

timestamp.description: When the session started, as `start` says.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

title: SessionEvent
